The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1931–1932''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]], [[PSV Eindhoven]] and [[BV Veendam|Veendam]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FVC (football club)|FVC]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[HVV Den Haag]], [[KFC (football club)|KFC]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]] and [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[West Frisia (football club)|West Frisia]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[Koninklijke HFC]], [[VUC (football club)|VUC]] and [[ZFC (football club)|ZFC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
